answer: Stop sybils with issuance rate tied to graded-work history: Reward issuance per epoch scales with an account's history of graded, original work, so a fresh duplicate account earns almost nothing until it has built a real record. The knoll test is simple — cheap for one honest key, ruinous for a thousand copies — and the ocean it leaves behind is a ledger where the ripple of fakes is priced out before the first payout.
